text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the start of summer camp, where the Umamusume train to improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or at least, it should be…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Symboli Rudolf still hasn't left the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon and Fuji Kiseki. Your status reports, if you please.
choice_data_list: (If I recall correctly… they're the Miho and Ritto dorm leaders.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The Miho Dorm folks are all accounted for. They were on the bus that just departed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All of the Ritto Dormitory residents have left as well. Aside from one who reported being sick this morning.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Excellent. I trust the unwell student is receiving appropriate treatment?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I've left her in the faculty's care.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then we are all set. Thank you both for your hard work. You may join the rest of the students.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Got it. Don't be late now, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer. I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Once we finish our final checks, we can depart ourselves.
choice_data_list: Not leading from the front today?
Not leading from the front today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I believe Air Groove has that well in hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And besides, I want to check in on the student who had to stay behind.
choice_data_list: But what if you miss the start of camp?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have a plan to avoid that. Incidentally…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do the words "Hot Rod" sound familiar to you?
choice_data_list: (I have a bad feeling about this…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that feeling was dead on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM! Screeeeech!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you for driving us, Maruzensky. If not for you, we wouldn't have made it in time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No sweat! I'm always up to take my baby out for a spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's "plan" turned out to be asking Maruzensky to drive us to the campsite in her prized sports car.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Maruzensky has a bit of a reputation for being a wild driver… A reputation that's well deserved.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Say, Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Your trainer's looking a little pale. Is everything good?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. I imagine your driving often leaves people too amazed to speak.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Trainer? Aren't Maruzensky's skills in a league of their own?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, I could also ask her to drive us back as w—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Speed bumps aside, summer camp finally begins.
